newsitem.title: USA: Barshefky--removing ag barriers high priority.
newsitem.headline: Barshefky--removing ag barriers high priority.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative nominee Charlene Barshefsky said Wednesday that removing agricultural trade barriers was a high priority for the next four years.

"Removing agricultural barriers wherever they exist is one of our highest priorities of the next four years, so follow-on negotiations in the WTO (World Trade Organization) are extremely important," she said in testimony to the Senate Finance Committee.
While the Uruguay Round reduced some of the most difficult barriers to agricultural trade, "our work is far from done," Barshefsky said.

"We will vigorously enforce the agreement from the Uruguay Round and focus on the sanitary and phytosanitary area, where 'health standards' are routinely invoked without justification to block our exports," she said in prepared testimony.
